Changes take effect on the next launch. Existing data stays in the original directory and is not moved automatically.
chooseLocationDetail: Use the new directory on the next launch. Existing data will be kept.
restoreTarget: Choose an Empty Directory to Restore Into
installDetail: Restart and install now, or continue later from Check for Updates. Updates are not installed automatically when quitting.
updateUnsupported: Automatic updates are not available in this build
previewUpdateDetail: Development preview {version}. Automatic updates require a signed installer and a configured release source.
unconfiguredUpdate: This build has no update source configured. Use an official release package to upgrade.
downloadDetail: Current version: {version}. After downloading, you can choose when to restart and install.
updateFailedDetail: Check your network connection and try again. Your current version and local data are retained.
secureStorageUnavailable: OS secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your login keychain and try again. Existing keys will not be replaced or reset.
credentialsUnreadable: The saved credentials could not be decrypted. If you previously used a development or unsigned build, migrate with the original trusted runtime. Existing data and keys are retained.
credentialsMismatch: No credentials match the existing local database. Migrate the original instance keys; reinstalling or restarting will not repair this. Your existing data is retained.
macSignatureRequired: This macOS app is not signed with a valid Developer ID Application certificate. Install an official signed release. Use the isolated source development command for local previews. No local database or credentials have been opened.
